comment: Rotating ring oscilloscope on the pedal screen (MS-70CDR 2.10, zvis). Pass-through; the signal is wrapped around a circle that spins. Firmware facts: Leemuzhko's ZOOM_development SDK (credited, own code).

params.name: Time
params.comment: How much signal goes around the ring: 1-64 samples per point.

params.name: Size
params.comment: How far the signal pushes the ring in and out.

params.name: Spin
params.comment: 50 = still; below spins one way, above the other.
